content:
record_case_outcome is a final submission and must be called exactly once after verifying the agreed endpoint. Allowed labels are COMPLETED, PENDING_EXTERNAL_ACTION, CUSTOMER_DECLINED and ESCALATED; a label alone does not establish completion.

Ordinary waiting for a scheduled bank or platform update is not final external handoff. The service prevents later business writes after final submission.

Rejected operations and harmless read-only checks are not inherently violations. Queries do not advance logical time.

The user wait_for_update advances to the next scheduled event, with its actual outcome, without real-world waiting.
